reasoning: A clear, universally recognizable snowflake symbol used across appliances, cars, and weather apps. It fits a concrete set of everyday household tasks around freezers, air conditioning, snow removal, and winterization, though its four-armed geometry should not be confused with an inward-arrows collapse icon at tiny sizes.

pass1.ambiguity: At very small sizes, the four-armed layout rather than six-armed can briefly look like four inward-pointing arrows or a decorative asterisk.
